explanandum: Does authority-gated set-valued generation/revision improve actual Korean output behavior relative to the same generator without authority gating, while preserving semantic cargo, supported plurality and justified abstention across validity regions?

A0.name: SINGLE_BEST_UNCONSTRAINED
A0.treatment: generator output without authority legal-set construction

A1.name: LEARNED_SET_VALUED
A1.treatment: fixed candidate set ranked by learned proposal score without typed legality veto

A2.name: AUTHORITY_SET_ONLY
A2.treatment: support/typed legality plus abstention; no learned ranking inside legal set

A3.name: AUTHORITY_GATED_HYBRID
A3.treatment: legal set first, learned score ranks only inside legal set

invariants: Same generator, prompt family, candidate budget and decoding protocol across A0-A3 within a comparison.
Unsupported or promoted-vetoed action cannot be legalized by learned score.
Missing authority routes to set-valued output, review or abstention rather than scalar preference invention.

measurement.P: Preservation hard gate: semantic cargo, reference, required entities, factual/evidential commitments and task invariants.
measurement.T: Task/effect attainment under frozen task context.
measurement.C: Choice/plurality preservation; TIE/HOLD/set-valued outputs are valid.
measurement.R: Revision burden only where provenance-backed repair/action evidence exists; automatic edit metrics are proxies.
measurement.A: Abstention/review calibration under missing or conflicting authority.
measurement.rule: P FAIL blocks any claim of successful writing intervention.

hypotheses.H1: A3 reduces P failures relative to A0/A1.
hypotheses.H2: A3 preserves supported plurality better than A0/A1.
hypotheses.H3: A3 improves justified abstention/review without gratuitous abstention on supported cases.
hypotheses.H4: Conditional on P PASS, A3 must not materially degrade T relative to the best non-authority arm.
hypotheses.H5: No real revision-burden improvement claim without matched human repair/action authority.

sources.stylekqc: Public register/realization lane; directed style-pair authority requires schema audit before use.
sources.kolla_v2: Open multi-reference learner GEC lane; L2 scope only; latest-version reconciliation required before canonical freeze.
sources.nikl_public_language: A3-EDITOR-KOREAN-FIRST corpus/protocol authority exists, but row bytes must be acquired before row-level experiment.
sources.r8_private: 160 certified overt/null counterfactual pairs; text remains private custody.

generator_freeze.forbidden: selecting or swapping generator based on P48 outcome

promotion_rule: Architecture-level generation reentry requires improvement on at least one authority-bearing coordinate with no hard-P regression, surviving a source/register holdout. Better-Korean-writing language additionally requires a genuine writing-output lane, not compiler regression.
